description: Pre-install review framework for AI agent skills: inspect complete content, permissions, dependencies and suspicious behavior before activation.
Validate Claude Code skills against the agentskills specification. Catches structural, semantic, and naming issues before users do.

Create and review reusable skill drafts with bundled Python scaffolding, basic frontmatter validation and ZIP packaging helpers. Use for skill authoring and packaging; verify target-host requirements separately.
Guide for creating effective skills for AI coding agents working with Azure SDKs and Microsoft Foundry services. Use when creating new skills or updating existing skills.

Comprehensive guide for creating and managing skills in Claude Code with auto-activation system, using an illustrative custom hook architecture and concise progressive disclosure and progressive disclosure pattern.
Skill gap register: employee, skill area, current against required level, gap severity and recommended training. Use for capability planning.

Iteratively improve a Claude Code skill using the skill-reviewer agent until it meets quality standards. Use when improving a skill with multiple quality issues, iterating on a new skill until it meets standards, or automated fix-review cycles instead of manual editing.
Validate and install explicitly selected local skill trees into a workspace, with full-tree Claude registration, backups and ZIP packaging.
Find out why a coding-agent skill won't fire — grade each SKILL.md A–F on activation, simulate which skill a prompt triggers, and flag collisions where one silently shadows another.
Diagnose and optimize Agent Skills (SKILL.md) with real session data and research-backed static analysis. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and any Agent Skills-compatible agent.
Preview conservative tool-name translations and copy complete local skill bundles for manual adaptation to Google Antigravity.
Analyze Rails apps and provide upgrade assessments
Use when the user is unsure which skill to use or where to start. Interviews the user with targeted questions and recommends the best skill(s) from the installed library for their goal.
Scan agent skills for security issues before adoption. Detects prompt injection, malicious code, excessive permissions, secret exposure, and supply chain risks.
Audit an Agent Skill, MCP server, connector, or desktop extension before installation by tracing code, dependencies, permissions, credentials, data flow, and irreversible actions.
Convert approved documentation, repositories, or PDFs into an agent skill using the Skill Seekers workflow, then review the generated content.
Auditoria e evolucao do ecossistema de skills. Qualidade de codigo, seguranca, custos, gaps, duplicacoes, dependencias e relatorios de saude.
Write, upgrade or audit a Claude skill so it changes what gets generated: forcing functions, triggerable descriptions, and a static audit script with a 0-100 health score. Use for 写 skill, 改 skill.
Scan prompt history for recurring patterns and unmet needs, then propose new skills or command templates
Create and improve agent skills following the Agent Skills specification. Use when asked to create, write, or update skills.
